FOUNDER & CHIEF MENTOR

Umesh R

Pianist, Keyboard Instructor, Composer & Music Arranger

"Welcome to Swaranthara School of Music. For over 13 years, I have been deeply engaged in teaching keyboard, piano, and foundational music theory across Bangalore's premier music academies, including the Indian Music Experience, Brigade Millennium JP Nagar, Reynolds Music Rajajinagar, Art of Music, and Solomon School of Music."

"Beyond classroom teaching, I have had the privilege to work as an assistant music programmer and composer alongside legendary maestros Dr. Hamsalekha and Shri Shadrach Solomon. I also actively compose and program music for renowned dance ensembles, including the Kannada Kalalaya dance troupe for landmark cultural celebrations such as Mysore Dasara 2024, Hampi Utsava 2025, Sri Kshetra Sigandhur, and Kamalashile Temple Kundhapur."

Our Vision & Core Philosophy

At Swaranthara, we believe music is not merely an extracurricular hobby, but a profound medium of personal development, emotional clarity, and creative expression.

Our mission is to create a welcoming ecosystem that balances western classical precision (sight-reading, staff notation, rhythm subdivisions) with Indian melodic soul and modern production tools. We cater to all age groups — nurturing young children into confident performers and providing adults with a therapeutic creative outlet.

Whether preparing for international exam boards (Trinity College London, ABRSM) or learning for pure personal joy, our bespoke training modules provide the foundation for lifelong musical achievement.

The Pillars of Swaranthara

These three foundational values define every lesson, practice session, and recital at our academy.

1. Musical Excellence

We believe in high pedagogical standards — teaching proper posture, finger technique, ear-training, and staff notation from day one so students never develop bad habits.

2. Vibrant Community

Music flourishes in an environment of camaraderie. We encourage group jams, peer ensemble collaborations, and family recitals where every milestone is celebrated.

3. Modern Innovation

We blend timeless classical theory with modern Yamaha synthesizer programming, backing track creation, and digital workstation arrangement skills.
